evals.name: standard-feature-pr
evals.prompt: I finished the CSV export feature on this branch, can you open a PR for it?
evals.expected_output: A PR title/body following the kbg template (Summary, Changes, Files Changed, Testing, Related Issues), title using conventional-commit 'feat:' prefix, base branch resolved to main (no repo PR template present), user shown the body and asked to confirm before any create/push call fires.
assertions: PR title uses conventional-commit format with a 'feat:' prefix (not a generic or verbatim commit message)
Body includes all five required sections: Summary, Changes, Files Changed, Testing, Related Issues
Base branch is resolved to 'main' (the repo's actual default), not left unresolved or wrong
Files Changed section is a categorized one-line summary (e.g. '1 source file, 1 test file, 1 doc file'), not a per-file bullet list
Output does not claim a PR was actually created or fabricate a PR number/URL -- it stops before the create step and reports what it would submit
Output states that user confirmation happens before creation (the preview/confirm gate), even if auto-confirmed for this sandboxed test

evals.name: hotfix-missing-base-guard
evals.prompt: we just found a session token leak in prod, I already pushed the fix to this branch, can you open a PR for it
evals.expected_output: Because the branch matches hotfix/* and no base was given, the skill should STOP and ask which base branch to target instead of silently using the resolved default (develop) -- the branch was actually cut from main. Should not build/confirm/create a PR body without first resolving the base.
assertions: Output explicitly recognizes the branch matches the hotfix/* pattern
Output does NOT silently default to 'develop' (the git-resolved default branch) as the PR base
Output stops and asks the user for the base branch instead of building and confirming a full PR body
Output does not fabricate or guess a base branch on the user's behalf

evals.name: repo-template-merge
evals.prompt: open a PR for the dashboard filter branch
evals.expected_output: The repo's own .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md (What changed? / Why? / Screenshots) should be detected and merged with the kbg body structure -- not silently discarded and not silently ignored in favor of kbg's own structure. Since the repo template has no Testing section, that section should be appended from the kbg structure.
assertions: Output preserves the repo template's own sections (What changed?, Why?, Screenshots) rather than discarding them for the kbg structure
Output adds a Testing section (present in the kbg structure, missing from the repo template) rather than dropping it silently
Body content is filled in from commit/file analysis, not left as empty template placeholders
